notes.title: May 15, the birthday of the game developer
notes.content: May 15, the birthday of the game developer, you can buy the game at a discount :)

notes.title: The first player to make a screenshot of the right button combination on the shop level will receive 20 Steam keys for the game and my thanks!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello, players![/b][/h1]
While creating the game, I tried to put a lot of secret into the levels. These secrets typically contain useful items. 
BUT! There is one secret that is unlike the rest! So, here it goes, I am declaring a contest! 
[b]The first player to make a screenshot of the right button combination on the shop level will receive 20 Steam keys for the game and my thanks![/b]

notes.title: Linux and Mac versions coming soon!
notes.content: Linux and Mac versions coming soon!

notes.title: The game will be released on April 10, 1pm PDT (that's April 10, 20:00 UTC)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32845833/24f3b9978aff22dd7bb51069569f14603c7af426.png[/img]
Hello everyone!
The long-awaited release that was scheduled for April 9 had to be delayed again, for a day! All because I got confused about timezones.
The game will be released on April 10, 1pm PDT (that's April 10, 20:00 UTC)
